summary.headline: Planetary House Significations
summary.text: Astrological significations of planets in the second, third, and fourth houses: wealth, family property, siblings, friends, journeys, inheritances, treasures, parental death, and security, with Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, Sun, Venus, Mercury, and Moon discussed.
